senses.gloss: स्फुरित- + रुचि स्फुरित- + रुचि, adj. having a trembling (glittering) splendour, Megh. 15.

स्फुट् स्फुट् (akin to स्फुर्, स्फुल्; probably for original *स्पर्त्; O.H.G. spaltan; Engl. split), i. 6, Par., and † i. 1, Ātm.
 1. (also † i. 1, Par., and † स्फुण्ट् स्फुण्ट्, स्फट् स्फट्, † स्फण्ट् स्फण्ट्, i. 1, Par.), To burst, Utt. Rāmac. 77, 15; MBh. 1, 3023.
 2. To open, to expand (as a flower), Pañc. i. d. 152.
 3. To disperse, to run away, Bhaṭṭ. 10, 8. स्फुटित,
 1. Burst, broken, destroyed, Pañc. 98, 1; 254, 23 (cf. 42, 10).
 2. Splay (as feet), Pañc. 104, 15.
 --Caus., or i. 10,
 1. स्फोटय, To break, to divide, to tear open, Pañc. 87, 7; to destroy, Pañc. 42, 10.
 2. † स्फुटय, [] To burst, to appear.
 3. स्फाटय, स्फाटित, Cleft, Hit. 49, 11.
 --With आ आ, Caus., or i. 10, स्फोटय,
 1. To cause to sound, MBh. 3, 11139.
 2. To strike, Lass. 30, 18; especially one's own arm with the hand (perhaps rather, to snap the fingers, cf. स्फोटन), Man. 4, 64.
 3. To pat, MBh. 3, 1780.
 --With प्र प्र, Caus., or i. 10, To pierce, MBh. 4, 2100.
† स्फुट्ट् स्फुट्ट्, i. 10, Par. To slight, to despise.

स्फुट स्फुट् + अ, and perhaps at the same time a form of स्पष्ट, with उ, by the influence of the labial, फ् by that of स्, cf. स्फटिक,
 I. adj.
 1. Broken, rent.
 2. Opened, expanded (as a flower), Utt. Rāmac. 81, 5.
 3. Spread.
 4. Loud, Rām. 6, 8, 45.
 5. Manifest, evident, Kir. 11, 44.
 6. Plain, distinct, Pañc. iii. d. 109, i. d. 180 (without duplicity).
 7. White, bright, Bhartṛ. 3, 23.
 8. Known.
 II. टम्, adv. Distinctly, Pañc. 167, 15; evidently, Hit. iii. d. 89; certainly, Nalod. 2, 41.
 III. f. टा, A snake's expanded hood, Pañc. iii. 135.
 --Comp.
स्फुटता स्फुट + ता, f. Perspicuity, Kir. 2, 27.

स्फुटन स्फुट् + अन, n.
 1. Tearing, rending.
 2. Opening, expanding.
स्फुटार्थ स्फुटार्थ, i. e. स्फुट-अर्थ, adj. Intelligible, obvious.

स्फुटि and स्फुटी स्फुट् + ई̆, f.
 1. Kibe, swelling of the feet.
 2. A sort of melon.
स्फुटिका स्फुटिका, i. e. स्फुट् + अक, f. A small piece (?), Daśak. in Chr. 199, 17.
† स्फुड् स्फुड्, i. 6, Par. To cover.
स्फुण्ट् स्फुण्ट्, see स्फण्ड्, स्फुट्.
† स्फुण्ड् स्फुण्ड्, i. 1, Ātm. To open, to expand (cf. स्फुट्); see स्फण्ड्.
स्फुत्कार स्फुत्-कार (स्फुत्, an imitative sound), m. Crackling, burning.

स्फुर् स्फुर्, also स्फर् स्फर्, (which appears only in the Caus. and derivative nouns; nevertheless, it is the original form, its अ being changed to उ by the combined influence of the preceding labial and the accent of the sixth conj. cl.), i. 6, Par.
 1. To tremble, MBh. 3, 1867; to palpitate, Mṛcch. 143, 14; to throb, Mālat. 5, 5.
 2. To struggle, Pañc. iii. d. 123; to rebound, Johns. Sel. 48, 83.
 3. To break forth, Gīt. 11, 1; Hit. ii. d. 59 (पुरः स्फुरन्त्, Springing up before one's eyes).
 4. To flash, to shine, to sparkle, Gīt. 10, 6; Hit. ii. d. 52; Pañc. i. d. 33; Vikr. d. 136.
 5. To destroy (ved.). स्फुरित,
 1. Shaken.
 2. Trembling, Pañc. 64, 15; throbbing.
 3. Glittering, Megh. 15; shining, Mālat. 40, 10.
 4. Swollen. n.
 1. Trembling, motion, MBh. 1, 1258.
 2. Throbbing of the eyelids, the quivering of the lip, Kumāras. 7, 18.
 --Caus. स्फारय, and † स्फोरय, To cast, Lass. 66, 8. स्फारित,
 1. Throbbing, Mālat. 60, 12.
 2. Spread, large, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 552.
 --With अभि अभि, अभि-स्फुरित,
 1. Expanded, in full bloom.
 2. Known.
 --With परि परि, परिस्फुरित,
 1. Glanced.
 2. Glancing.
 3. Expanded, Utt. Rāmac. 72, 10.
 --With प्र प्र, To tremble, MBh. 3, 11498. प्रस्फुरित,
 1. Trembling, Johns. Sel. 22, 112.
 2. Swollen, Pañc. 220, 1.
 3. [] Budded.
 --With वि वि,
 1. To tremble, MBh. 3, 15639.
 2. To struggle, MBh. 1, 6001.
 3. To glitter, Kathās. 26, 283. विस्फुरित,
 1. Tremulous, shaken, Utt. Rāmac. 117, 10.
 2. Swollen, enlarged.
 --Caus. स्फारय,
 1. To draw (a bow), Rām. 3, 30, 28; Kir. 17, 24.
 2. To cause to flash, MBh. 3, 404. विस्फारित,
 1. Trembling.
 2. Flashing, Rām. 1, 54, 19.
 3. Twanged or drawn, as a bowstring, Kir. 14, 31.
 4. Evident.
 --Cf. σπαίρω (i. e. σπαρ + ϳω; the Sskr. फ् is produced by the influence of स्), ἀ-σπαίρω, probably σπείρω, σπέρμα, σποράς; the ved. use shows that hither belong also A.S. spurnan; σϕυρόν; A.S. spura; probably Lat. sperno. Cf. स्खल्.

स्फुर स्फुर् + अ, m.
 1. Trembling, Pañc. iii. d. 237; throbbing.
 2. Swelling.
 3. A shield.

स्फुरण स्फुरण, i. e. स्फुर् + अन, n.
 1. Trembling, Bhāg. P. 3, 26, 29 (trembling appearance).
 2. Quivering of the lips, throbbing of the eyes.
 3. Expansion of the mind, Pañc. 42, 6.
 4. Breaking forth, flashing, Megh. 28; glittering, Mālat. 143, 5.

† स्फुर्छ् स्फुर्छ् (i. e. स्फुर् + छ्), स्वुर्छ् स्वुर्छ्, i. 1, स्फूर्च्छ, स्वूर्च्छ, Par.
 1. To expand.
 2. To forget.

स्फुर्ज् स्फुर्ज् (i. e. स्फुर् + ज्), i. 1, स्फूर्ज, Par. To thunder, Bhaṭṭ. 15, 41.
 --With वि वि, विस्फूर्जित, Resounding (as arrows), Bhāg. P. 2, 7, 25. n.
 1. Roar (of the wind), Arj. 8, 6 (read स्फूर्ज्˚).
 2. Increase, Ragh. 13, 12, Calc. Sch.
 --Cf. Lat. spargo; A.S. sprecan; spraencan, sprengan, sprincan, springan.

स्फुल् स्फुल् (originally = स्फुर्), also स्फल् स्फल्, which, like स्फर्, [] appears only in the Caus. and derivative nouns, i. 6, Par.
 1. † To tremble, to throb.
 2. † To appear.
 3. † To collect.
 --With आ आ, Caus. स्फालय,
 1. To strike, Utt. Rāmac. 123, 4; Ragh. 16, 13; to touch, Utt. Rāmac. 150, 8 (?).
 2. To crush, Pañc. 93, 17.
 --With वि वि, To move cheerfully, Bhaṭṭ. 9, 76.
 --Cf. σϕάλλω (Caus.); O.H.G. fallan; A.S. feallan; Lat. fallere. Cf. स्खल्.
स्फुल स्फुल् + अ, n. A tent.
स्फुलन स्फुल् + अन, n. Trembling, throbbing.

स्फुलिङ्ग स्फुलिङ्ग, probably स्फुल् + अ + म्-ग, m., f. गा, n. A spark of fire, Vikr. d. 125.
 --Comp.
स्फुलिङ्गिन् स्फुलिङ्गिन्, adj., f. नी, Having sparks of fire, Mārk. P. 99, 57.

स्फूर्ज स्फूर्ज, i. e. स्फुरिज् + अ, m.
 1. The sound of thunder.
 2. Indra's thunderbolt.
स्फूर्जथु स्फूर्जथु, i. e. स्फुर्ज् + अथु, m. A thunderclap, Mahāvīrac. 124, 1.
स्फूर्ति स्फूर्ति, i. e. स्फुर् + ति, f. Shaking, Bhartṛ. 3, 34; throbbing, Windischmann, Sankara, 12.

स्फूर्तिमन्त् स्फूर्ति + मन्त्, adj., f. मती,
 1. Tremulous.
 2. Kind-hearted.
